program:
alphabet a b c

is_bos = bos
is_a = symbol a
is_b = symbol b
is_c = symbol c
h1_1 = rightmost(!is_b@i, !is_bos@i & !is_b@i & !is_a@j & !is_b@j)
h2_1 = rightmost(!is_a@i & is_b@i & !is_c@i & !h1_1@i & !is_a@j, !is_a@i & !is_c@i)
h3_1 = rightmost(!is_bos@i & !is_a@i & is_b@i & !is_c@i & !is_c@j, !is_a@i & is_b@i)
h4_1 = rightmost(!is_bos@j & !is_a@j & !is_b@j & is_c@j & !h2_1@j & !h3_1@j, !h1_1@i & !is_bos@j & !is_a@j)
h5_1 = rightmost(!h1_1@i & !is_bos@j & !is_a@j & is_c@j & !h3_1@j, !h1_1@i & !is_bos@j)
accept = !is_bos & !is_b & !h2_1 & !h3_1 & !h4_1 & !h5_1

output accept
